product__havoc-scout.title: HAVOC Scout - Havoc Watches
product__havoc-scout.desc: The HAVOC Sentinel is a stainless steel automatic dress watch, equally at home in the gym as it is beneath the cuff of a shirt, suit, or jacket. Designed for versatility, it combines refined styling with everyday durability, making it suited to both professional and active lifestyles. The 39mm stainless steel case delivers exceptional strength while remaining lightweight for every day wear. Protecting the dial is a sapphire crystal, offering superior scratch resistance and long-term clarity. The watch is also water resistant to 200 meters, making it suitable for swimming, water sports, and harsh environments. At the heart of the HAVOC Sentinel is the trusted NH35 automatic movement, known for its durability and reliability. Powered by motion, it requires no battery and keeps time through the energy of your movement. The Sentinel comes fitted with a three link stainless steel bracelet, combining the security of durability and comfort built for performance in all conditions. The result is a watch built with the same philosophy as the equipment that inspired it: functional, reliable, and ready for anything.
